answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the shale of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the karst re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the trellis is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
